witness.emotions: Male, around 30-40 years old, shocked but composed

dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Send people here! Now! At [[ADDRESS]]
Send people here! Now! At 217 Main Street!
Send people here! Now! At 1506 Sunshine Boulevard!
Send people here! Now! At 45 Long Drive!
{WHAT HAPPENED?} Alright what happened?
A plane has crashed into a house!
{WHAT PLANE?} What type of plane? A large one or a small one?
A small one... two seater, I guess!
{IS THERE FIRE?} Is anything on fire?
There's some smoke coming out from the rooftop, but I can't see the flames.
{ANYONE INSIDE?} Can you tell if there is anyone inside the house?
No, a woman ran outside. She said she was alone and she's not injured, but I can tell she's in deep shock.
{IS ANYONE INJURED?} Is there anyone else there who's injured?
I think whoever was in the plane is dead, but I'm not sure... Can't see them!
{ANY SURVIVORS?} Can you make it through to see if there is any survivors?
You sure I should go in there?
{HELP THEM}Yes, go and try to help!
Ok, I will try!
{NOT IF IT'S DANGEROUS}Not if it is any danger to you in any way, ok?
Then I'll better stay! Send someone here quick!
{HELP IS ON THE WAY}Okay, the emergency services are on the way, they should be there soon.

reportElement.texten: The caller was a plane crash witness. He informed the dispatcher about disaster.
The caller got injured while trying to make his way to the victims.
